_help: The loading card's tips (scripts/loader.gd), one shown at a time, in turn from a random start. {action} becomes the key bound now (Controls.fill). Edit freely.
tips: {dodge}: a dodge roll. For a moment nothing can touch you, so roll through trouble, not away from it.
A companion who goes down isn't dead yet. Get to them and press {cover} to help them up before the enemy closes in.
A downed companion only bleeds while enemies are near. Clear the ground around them and they'll keep.
Rest at a camp fire or in a hotel bed to save. A fall in a fight brings you back to your last rest, or to the start of the fight.
{cover} beside a wall or a crate takes cover. Aim to lean out; let go to duck back in.
In cover behind something low, {move_forward} and {cover} vault over it.
Count your shots: a revolver holds six, and {reload} takes longer than you'd like.
{party_order}: tell your companions to hold where they stand, or to follow you again.
{crouch}: crouch. Harder to see, harder to hit.
Everything you learn goes in the journal ({journal}): clues, people, places, and the road you took.
In Cairo every errand costs time: three actions a day. Buying is free; talking is not.
The first expedition to reach Akmentar picks first. A slow road costs you the best of the ruins.
{holster}: put the gun away. People talk more easily to someone who isn't pointing a revolver at them.
Scarabs can't bear fire. Keep to the torchlight and keep moving.
Hold {objective} to see what you came here to do.
{sprint}: sprint. Some doors only stay open for those who run.
